about.headline: About SCLegal
about.content: Seung (Steve) Choi is the Founder and Principal of SCLegal, bringing 25 years of legal experience in the U.S. and internationally to the practice of law. A graduate of the University of Southern California (B.S., Business Administration/Finance), Steve obtained his law degree from Loyola Law School, Los Angeles (J.D.) and LL.M. (with Distinction) from Georgetown University Law Center. Prior to founding SCLegal, Steve practiced law with leading international law firms including as an associate in the Project Finance practice of Linklaters LLP in Hong Kong and as partner with Lee & Ko, a leading corporate law firm in Seoul, South Korea. Steve currently counsels startups, early-stage companies, and venture capital funds investing in areas of high-tech, entertainment, healthcare, biomedical device, digital and social media, advertising, gaming, software, and crypto/blockchain.
